description: The hud section — the world-scope HUD panel rows plus their defaults (see WorldHudSection). presentation-only: overlay geometry and bindings, never simulation state. Defaults to Default (enabled, no authored panels) — byte-identical boot behavior for every world authored before this section existed.

enabled.description: Whether the world-scope HUD panels render at all — a world-level kill switch independent of any individual panel's row (a diegetic reveal gate can flip this without editing every panel).

cursor.description: The drawn pointer cursor's presentation policy, or null to fall back to Default (the optional-section null-coalesce convention). Whole-row replace semantics apply: a SetHudDefaults authored without it clears any earlier authored policy back to the default.

hoverRadius.description: The cursor ray's hover reach in world units — how far into the world a pointer resolves a hovered row.

sizePx.description: The drawn cursor's ring radius, pixels.

role.description: The bare cursor's palette role; hover lights the accent tier regardless.

panels.description: Gets the authored world-scope panels. The absence-coalesce lives in the accessor for the same reason Response's does.

items.description: One HUD panel row — a stable id (unique within the section), a normalized viewport rect in screen space, which band it draws in, its chrome style, and its child elements. WorldMutation.UpsertHudPanel carries the whole row (elements included) as one cross-row transaction boundary; WorldMutation.UpsertHudElement/ WorldMutation.RemoveHudElement read-modify-write a single element within an already-declared panel.

id.description: The panel's stable id (unique within the section — the world.row.set hud.panels/world.row.remove hud.panels mutation address).

rect.description: The panel's viewport rect, normalized to screen space.

layer.description: Which band the panel draws in.

elements.description: Gets the panel's child elements. The absence-coalesce lives in the accessor for the same reason Response's does.
